input.summary: Add a Teleglobe-only convenience withdrawal right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts.
input.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 18.1 locks us in for a 25-year Initial Period with no convenience exit, which is our walk-away position. We have added a Teleglobe-only right to withdraw for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid amounts; the other Parties' exit right stays limited to the end of the Initial Period on one year's notice. If you prefer, we can move to our fallback of 60-90 days' notice with any early-termination fee capped at three months' charges.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Subparagraph 18.1, Teleglobe USA Inc. may terminate its participation in this Agreement for convenience at any time, including during the Initial Period, by giving not less than thirty (30) days' prior notice thereof, in writing, to the other Parties, and the other Parties shall refund to Teleglobe USA Inc., pro rata, any amounts prepaid by it in respect of the period after the effective date of such termination.
